• Premium and Lightweight Sport Packs: Enhance the GTs luxury appointments and performance-focused character.

• Front and Rear Parking Sensors with Rear Camera: Provide added assistance when maneuvering in confined spaces.

OVERVIEW
The 2021 Mercedes-AMG GT Black Series is the result of an uncompromising fusion of motorsport technology, aerodynamic mastery, and handcrafted power. Under the long sculpted hood lies a re-engineered 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 with a flat-plane crankshaft, producing 720 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and rear-wheel drive, the GT Black Series accelerates from 0-60 mph in just 3.1 seconds and reaches a top speed of 202 mph. Power delivery is instantaneous, linear, and ferocious. The Black Series name is reserved for the rarest and most focused AMG models, and this GT wears it proudly. Its carbon-fiber bodywork and a massive adjustable rear wing generate track-level downforce. A race-derived coil-over suspension with adaptive damping, carbon-ceramic brakes, and Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 R tires ensure razor-sharp handling and unshakeable grip. Inside, the GT Black Series remains unapologetically driver-focused. Lightweight AMG Performance bucket seats, Alcantara upholstery, carbon-fiber trim, and silver contrast stitching set the tone for serious performance. The AMG digital cockpit and infotainment interface keep vital information front and center, while creature comforts like dual-zone climate control and Burmester premium audio make it surprisingly livable when the helmet comes off. Born on the racetrack, bred by AMG's most obsessive engineers, and built in limited numbers, the 2021 AMG GT Black Series represents the peak of Mercedes performance. For collectors and purists alike, it's one of the most extraordinary and capable front-engine supercars of the modern era.

OVERVIEW
The 2020 Ferrari 488 Pista is an embodiment of Ferrari mid-engine V8 mastery and a direct descendant of Maranello, Italy's most celebrated performance lineage. Developed using technology and lessons learned from Ferrari's racing programs, the Pista was engineered to deliver maximum performance on both road and track. Under the rear glass sits a 3.9-liter twin-turbocharged V8, engineered entirely in-house by Ferrari to deliver a screaming 710 horsepower and 561 lb-ft of torque. Coupled to a 7-speed dual-clutch F1 gearbox, the 488 Pista launches from 0-60 mph in just 2.7 seconds and pushes a top speed of 211 mph. The turbochargers have been tuned for virtually zero lag to deliver an uninterrupted wave of power accompanied by an iconic Italian exhaust note. Chassis weight is reduced through the use of carbon fiber body panels, lightweight interior components, and thinner glass, helping improve every aspect of performance. Ferrari's advanced Side Slip Control, magnetorheological suspension, and electronic differential work together to maximize grip while maintaining driver confidence. Visually, the 488 Pista is one of the brand's most purposeful modern designs. Wider openings, exposed carbon fiber, and available racing stripes give it a motorsport-inspired appearance without sacrificing elegance. Behind the wheel, the cabin wraps the driver in Rosso Ferrari leather, with the brand's signature manettino steering wheel and bolstered racing seats reminding you of its performance intentions. The integration of digital displays with classic analog cues ensures a driving experience that is both modern and timeless. By fusing timeless Italian design with cutting-edge engineering, the 2020 488 Pista stands as one of Ferrari's most focused GTs and a true future classic.

The driver-focused cabin combines sport performance with premium comfort, featuring Heated & Ventilated Power Front Bucket Seats upholstered in exclusive Black Nappa leather alongside heated rear seating. The memory seat and power adjustments ensure personalized positioning for every drive.

Safety and convenience integrate seamlessly throughout this vehicle. The Driver Assistance Package includes Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC®, Active Lane Change Assist, Active Steering Assist, Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function, Active Emergency Stop Assist, Active Speed Limit Assist, and Evasive Steering Assist. Additional features include Route-Based Speed Adaptation, Traffic Sign Assist, and PRE-SAFE® PLUS Rear-End Collision Protection for comprehensive protection.

The interior exemplifies automotive luxury and function. The Designo Black Dinamica headliner and AMG Light Display set the tone, while the 25-speaker Burmester® High-End 3D Surround Sound System with active subwoofer delivers premium audio throughout. Apple CarPlay®/Android Auto® integration, MBUX Infotainment and Navigation System, and SiriusXM radio keep you connected and entertained. Dual-zone automatic temperature control, heated front door panels, and armrests enhance every journey.

Exterior styling reflects its AMG® performance heritage. The AMG Night Package includes High-Gloss Black front splitter, mirror covers, rear diffuser insert, side sill inserts, and window trim, complemented by Black Chrome exhaust tips. The 21" AMG® Forged Cross-Spoke Black wheels are wrapped in performance tires designed for this vehicle's capabilities.

This 2021 Mercedes-Benz AMG® GT 63 S 4MATIC® represents a significant opportunity to own a driver's car with world-class engineering and luxury appointments. We invite you to visit our showroom for an in-person evaluation and test drive experience.

This 2016 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 3LZ represents a significant opportunity to own a performance machine that delivers on every front.

- Carbon Flash-Painted Ground Effects Package with aggressive splitter, rockers, and rear spoiler
- Carbon Flash Hood Stinger Stripe
- 19" x 10" front and 20" x 12" rear Z06 Chrome Aluminum Wheels
- 8-Speed Automatic with Paddle Shift and Automatic Modes
- Bose Premium 9-Speaker Audio System with SiriusXM Satellite Radio

- Head-Up Display

- Battery Protection Package
- Custom Leather Wrapped Interior with Sueded Microfiber-Wrapped Trim

The Z06 3LZ trim elevates this Corvette with premium appointments and purposeful styling. The aggressive carbon-painted ground effects and hood stinger stripe announce performance intent, while the 19-inch front and 20-inch rear Z06 chrome wheels provide an aggressive stance. The eight-speed automatic transmission with paddle shift puts control in your hands, allowing for spirited driving when you want it and refined comfort when you need it.

Inside, the custom leather wrapped interior with sueded microfiber accents creates a driver-focused environment. The heated and vented GT bucket seats provide support and comfort for long drives or track days. The sport steering wheel and telescoping column allow you to find your ideal position. Climate control extends to the front and rear, with rear window defrost for added convenience.

Technology integration is comprehensive. The Chevrolet MyLink system with navigation touchscreen works seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay. The Bose premium audio system with nine speakers ensures quality sound whether you're tuned to SiriusXM or your personal media. The head-up display keeps vital information in your line of sight, while the performance data and video recorder captures your driving moments.

Safety and visibility receive equal attention. Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars provides balanced handling. Front and rear curb view cameras guide you through tight spaces, and high-intensity discharge headlights illuminate the road ahead. Electronic stability control and traction control work to keep you planted, while multiple airbags and the occupant-sensing system provide protection.

With 13 city and 23 highway MPG, this Corvette balances performance with reasonable fuel economy. The 3LZ Preferred Equipment Group, Battery Protection Package, and Navigation system round out a comprehensive feature set designed for the discerning buyer who expects both capability and refinement.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this Z06 firsthand.

Factory-equipped with the desirable Executive Package, Parking Assistance Package, Icon Adaptive LED Headlights with Laserlight, Head-Up Display, Harman Kardon Surround Sound System, Extended Merino Leather upholstery, Extended Shadowline Trim, heated steering wheel, and Black Sapphire Metallic paint, this M4 carried an original MSRP of $78,245.

With nearly $85,000 invested, this M4 Coupe blends professionally molded widebody craftsmanship, custom-built BBS wheels, premium air suspension, extensive carbon fiber detailing, and a rare 6-speed manual transmission into an exceptionally well-executed enthusiast build. This Corvette has been meticulously cared for throughout its life and remains one of the finest examples you'll find on the market today. From its flawless exterior finish to its beautifully preserved interior, every inch of this Z06 reflects the pride of ownership it has received since new. Backed by its incredibly low mileage and exceptional presentation, this is the type of Corvette enthusiasts and collectors wait for.

The Head-Up Display projects critical information directly into your sightline, and the sport steering wheel places all controls within reach.

Technology seamlessly integrates throughout the cabin. The Live Cockpit Pro with navigation keeps you informed and connected, while the harman/kardon surround sound system elevates every drive. Smartphone integration through enhanced USB and Bluetooth connectivity ensures your devices work effortlessly with the vehicle. Remote engine start and the power tailgate add practical luxury to daily ownership.

Safety and convenience features work together to enhance your driving experience. Icon Adaptive LED headlights with laser light technology provide superior visibility, while parking assistance with Parking Assistant Plus handles challenging parking situations. Electronic stability control, traction control, multiple airbags, and a comprehensive brake system provide peace of mind on every journey.

This one-owner vehicle presents a clean Carfax history and shows 24,175 miles of careful use. The M Carbon exterior package, including carbon fiber trim and distinctive M Shadowline lighting, sets this Competition apart visually while the comprehensive Executive Package rounds out the premium feature set. Contact us today to experience this BMW M4 Competition firsthand.

This Corvette Stingray 2LT stands ready to deliver the response you expect from a machine engineered for serious drivers. Premium Laguna leather seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a heated, multi-function steering wheel combine luxury with convenience. This vehicle's performance is amplified by digital enhancements that bring power and control to the driver’s fingertips. Its 6.2L supercharged V8 engine, mated to an automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive, is managed by electronic throttle control for crisp, immediate response. Electronic drive systems optimize grip and stability, making spirited drives or city commutes equally engaging. The interplay of analog muscle with digital finesse creates a truly modern muscle car experience.

Smart safety systems work constantly in the Challenger to protect and inform. Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection use radar sensors to monitor hard-to-see areas, alerting drivers to potential hazards during lane changes or reverse maneuvers. The ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera provides a clear, real-time image to assist with parking and tight maneuvers, while Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and four-wheel ABS operate quietly in the background, using digital feedback to help maintain optimal control and prevent skids or lockups. These systems work together, leveraging processing power to reduce driver workload and increase confidence.

Every detail inside the Challenger’s cockpit is crafted for convenience and integration. The ventilated front seats with Hellcat logo Laguna leather offer year-round comfort, while the power tilt/telescope steering column and premium-stitched dash panels signal attention to both function and style. The Uconnect 4C system brings together navigation, SiriusXM radio, and smartphone integration on its 8.4-inch touchscreen. Audio controls are embedded in the sport steering wheel, ensuring drivers stay focused on the road while managing calls or music. Automatic dual-zone climate control and remote connectivity round out a technology suite designed for seamless daily use.

Against other muscle cars like the Ford Mustang GT and Chevrolet Camaro SS, this Challenger stands out for the sheer breadth of its tech features.

2012 Cadillac CTSV Coupe For Sale

This 2012 Cadillac CTS-V Coupe pairs the factory supercharged 6.2L LSA V8 with the Tremec 6-speed manual, a combination the consignor reports as 1 of 31 built in White Diamond Tricoat with the manual transmission. It's a built car, not a stock one, with a full supporting cast of fueling, breathing, and drivetrain upgrades behind the factory shortblock.

Power comes from the LSA, tuned by Big 3 Racing to a claimed 820 horsepower on E85. The supporting fuel and airflow package includes a 104mm throttle body and 1,300cc injectors, a ported blower snout for improved inlet flow, and a Brian Tooley Racing stage 3 cam and valvetrain. Long tube headers feed new high-flow catalytic converters and a Corsa exhaust, and the supercharger's intercooler cooling assembly, a factory weak point known to collapse and reduce coolant flow under boost, has been reinforced to hold up to the added output. A heavy-duty clutch has been installed to handle the power increase through the manual gearbox.

Handling has been addressed with Eibach 1-inch lowering springs and new rear magnetic shocks, keeping the factory Magnetic Ride Control system in play with fresh hardware. A Pedal Commander adjusts throttle response, and the car rides on new Nitto tires with a new battery installed. Inside, the black interior features heated and ventilated Recaro performance seats, a carbon-fiber-look center stack, navigation, tinted windows, and a power sunroof, with 50,000 miles on the odometer.

The LSA in this CTS-V is closely related to the LS9 that powered the C6 Corvette ZR1 and shares its core architecture with the Camaro ZL1's engine of the same name, using a smaller 1.9L supercharger against the LS9's 2.3L unit and making 556 horsepower in stock factory form. The CTS-V Coupe was only built from 2011 through 2015, and when the third-generation CTS-V arrived for 2016, it came as a sedan only, with no coupe body style and no manual transmission offered again. That makes this generation's two-door, manual-equipped CTS-V the only version of the model ever built that way, and the last one Cadillac will build.

description: The C8 Corvette represented the most significant change in the car's 68-year history. After seven generations of front-engine Corvettes, Chevrolet moved the engine behind the driver, fulfilling a goal that legendary Corvette engineer Zora Arkus-Duntov had first pursued in 1960. The result was a car that hit 60 miles per hour in 2.9 seconds with the Z51 package and the quarter mile in 11.2, numbers that put it on equal footing with Ferrari and McLaren models costing three to five times as much. This one is finished in Shadow Gray Metallic, a color that made up only 4 percent of C8 production and was retired entirely after the 2021 model year, meaning it cannot be ordered on any new Corvette. It was taken delivery of in the summer of 2021 and has been maintained in detailed condition since day one. Under the hood is the 6.2 liter LT2 V8 producing 495 horsepower and 470 pound-feet of torque with the performance exhaust, backed by the eight-speed dual-clutch automatic. The Z51 package brings the rear performance axle, electronic limited slip differential, Z51 suspension with magnetic selective ride control, Z51 brakes, high performance tires, Z51 rear spoiler, performance exhaust, and heavy-duty cooling system. The 39/61 front-to-rear weight distribution gives this car a traction and handling advantage that no front-engine Corvette could match. Inside, the 2LT package brings the GT2 bucket seats, and the car was ordered with torch red seatbelts, bright red painted brake calipers, and carbon flash painted exterior mirrors, 19 and 20 inch carbon flash aluminum wheels, and a battery protection package. An Edge red engine cover and GM black lug nuts add the finishing details. Both factory key fobs, the original build sheet, and the original window sticker come with the car along with service records and a clean Carfax. Shadow Gray is gone from the order sheet and will not come back. A fully documented, meticulously cared for Z51 2LT in a retired color with this level of factory optioning is exactly the kind of C8 that the collector market is beginning to pay serious attention to. description: ICONIC, EXHILARATING, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, AMERICA'S SUPERCAR HAS ARRIVED! The 2021 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Coupe marked one of the most significant moments in Corvette history by introducing the first production mid-engine Corvette ever built. By relocating the engine behind the driver, Chevrolet transformed the Stingray into a true world-class sports car with breathtaking performance, extraordinary balance, and exotic styling that rivals machines costing several times its original price. Every drive reminds you that this isn't simply another Corvette. Its mid-engine layout delivers incredible grip, razor-sharp handling, and outstanding driver confidence, creating an experience that's equally thrilling on a winding back road, at a track day, or simply cruising your favorite scenic highway. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The C8 Corvette became an instant sensation because it delivers genuine supercar performance without the six-figure price tag often associated with European exotics. Buyers appreciate its stunning acceleration, exceptional handling, everyday comfort, and surprisingly practical design, making it one of the most complete performance cars ever produced. Unlike many exotic sports cars, the Corvette is designed to be driven and enjoyed regularly. Excellent visibility, comfortable seating, generous luggage space provided by both the front trunk and rear cargo compartment, and remarkable refinement make it just as enjoyable during daily driving as it is on spirited weekend adventures. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The mid-engine Corvette Stingray received overwhelming praise from the automotive press for delivering world-class performance, remarkable engineering, and extraordinary value. Reviewers consistently described it as one of the greatest performance bargains ever produced, frequently comparing it to exotic sports cars costing well into six figures. Its combination of breathtaking acceleration, balanced handling, premium interior quality, and everyday usability helped establish the C8 as one of the most celebrated Corvettes in the model's legendary history. 2020 North American Car of the Year Car and Driver 10Best MotorTrend Car of the Year finalist Widely recognized as one of the world's best performance values Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 18,478-mile mark, and it has some supplemental factory coverage remaining. Corrosion Limited Warranty Protects against corrosion perforation of the body sheet metal. Expires: May 3, 2027 or 100,000 miles, whichever occurs first. Extended service plans may be available to provide additional peace of mind for years to come. Standard Features The 3LT trim transforms the Stingray into a true grand touring sports car by surrounding its incredible performance with premium leather, upscale materials, advanced technology, and exceptional attention to detail. Every control is positioned around the driver, reinforcing the cockpit-like environment inspired by world-class racing machinery. Despite its astonishing capabilities, the Corvette remains remarkably approachable. Comfortable seating, refined ride quality, excellent visibility, and surprising cargo versatility make it a sports car you'll actually look forward to driving every chance you get. Installed Options This Stingray was ordered with desirable factory upgrades that further enhance both its appearance and exhilarating soundtrack. Standalone Factory Options Performance Exhaust Enhances the already thrilling 6.2-liter V8 with a deeper, more aggressive exhaust note while also increasing output to 495 horsepower and 470 lb-ft of torque, allowing the Stingray to reach its full factory performance potential. Sebring Orange Tintcoat A vibrant premium exterior finish that perfectly complements the Corvette's exotic mid-engine styling and ensures it commands attention wherever it goes. Mechanical Features Mounted directly behind the driver is Chevrolet's legendary 6.2-liter LT2 naturally aspirated V8, producing an exhilarating 495 horsepower and 470 lb-ft of torque when equipped with the optional Performance Exhaust. Paired with a lightning-fast eight-speed dual-clutch transmission, gear changes occur in milliseconds, delivering seamless acceleration that feels more like an exotic supercar than a traditional American sports car. The mid-engine layout fundamentally transforms the Corvette's driving dynamics. By placing the engine closer to the center of the chassis, Chevrolet achieved outstanding weight distribution, remarkable cornering balance, and exceptional traction during hard acceleration. A sophisticated suspension, precise steering, and powerful performance brakes work together to create a driving experience that's both confidence inspiring and incredibly rewarding. Whether carving through mountain roads or enjoying a relaxed highway cruise, the Stingray feels composed, responsive, and unmistakably special. Exterior Features The C8 Corvette is unmistakable from every angle. Its dramatic mid-engine proportions, aggressive air intakes, sculpted bodywork, and razor-sharp LED lighting create an unmistakably exotic presence that turns heads whether it's parked or carving through your favorite stretch of pavement. Finished in breathtaking Sebring Orange Tintcoat, this Stingray looks every bit as exciting as it performs. The premium finish brilliantly accentuates the Corvette's muscular fenders, dramatic side air intakes, and flowing body lines, ensuring it stands out in any crowd. The removable roof panel allows you to enjoy open-air driving in just minutes, transforming the coupe into an open-top sports car whenever the mood strikes. Combined with the front trunk and rear cargo compartment, the Corvette offers a level of practicality rarely found in the exotic sports car segment. Interior Features Inside, the 3LT cabin demonstrates just how far Corvette has evolved. Rich premium leather, meticulous stitching, upscale materials, and a driver-focused cockpit create an environment that feels every bit worthy of the Corvette's supercar performance. The unique center console places critical controls within easy reach while wrapping the driver in a true performance-oriented cockpit. Every switch, display, and surface has been thoughtfully designed to maximize both ergonomics and driving enjoyment. Despite its breathtaking performance, the Corvette remains surprisingly comfortable for everyday driving. Supportive seating, excellent outward visibility, generous storage solutions, and refined cabin isolation make long-distance touring every bit as enjoyable as spirited back-road driving. Infotainment & Technology The 3LT trim surrounds the driver with cutting-edge technology designed to enhance every journey. A configurable digital instrument cluster and high-resolution infotainment touchscreen provide immediate access to navigation, entertainment, vehicle performance information, and connectivity features. Wireless Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, premium audio, voice recognition, multiple USB ports, performance data recording capabilities, and extensive vehicle customization allow you to tailor nearly every aspect of the driving experience. Whether you're selecting drive modes, monitoring performance data, or simply enjoying your favorite music, the Corvette's technology feels every bit as advanced as its engineering. Safety Features While the Corvette is engineered for extraordinary performance, Chevrolet also equipped it with an impressive array of advanced safety technologies designed to inspire confidence behind the wheel. A rigid aluminum chassis, multiple airbags, electronic stability control, traction management, anti-lock brakes, rear vision camera, tire pressure monitoring, and advanced performance braking systems all work together to help maintain control while protecting occupants. The Corvette's exceptional chassis balance, outstanding visibility, and sophisticated electronic driving aids further contribute to a driving experience that's both exhilarating and reassuring. ... and there's SO MUCH more! The 2015 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 3LZ is an elite American supercar that delivers breathtaking performance, world-class handling, premium luxury, and unmistakable styling. Engineered to compete with exotic sports cars costing significantly more, the Z06 combines track-ready capability with everyday comfort, making it one of the most impressive performance cars ever produced by Chevrolet. Equipped with the 3LZ Premium Equipment Group, Custom Leather Wrapped Interior Package, Sueded Microfiber-Wrapped Interior Trim Package, and Memory Package, this Corvette offers an extraordinary blend of luxury, technology, and raw performance.

At the heart of the Z06 is Chevrolet's legendary supercharged 6.2 liter LT4 V8 engine, producing an incredible 650 horsepower and 650 lb-ft of torque. Paired with either a lightning-fast eight-speed paddle-shift automatic transmission or a precise seven-speed manual transmission with Active Rev Matching, the Z06 delivers explosive acceleration and exhilarating performance. Launching from 0 to 60 mph in approximately 3 seconds, this Corvette offers supercar-level speed while maintaining outstanding everyday drivability.

The exterior styling is aggressive, aerodynamic, and unmistakably Corvette. A wider body, functional hood vent, front splitter, larger air intakes, rear spoiler, quad-performance exhaust, LED lighting, lightweight aluminum chassis, and premium alloy wheels create an unmistakable presence on the road while providing the cooling and downforce necessary for high-performance driving.

Inside, the 3LZ Premium Equipment Group transforms the cabin into a true luxury performance environment. Premium Napa leather covers nearly every major touchpoint, while the Custom Leather Wrapped Interior Package extends hand-stitched leather across the dashboard, center console, doors, and instrument panel for an exceptionally refined appearance.

The Sueded Microfiber-Wrapped Interior Trim Package further enhances the cabin with premium suede-like microfiber covering the steering wheel, shift knob, headliner, pillars, and other interior surfaces, creating a race-inspired atmosphere with exceptional attention to detail.

The Memory Package adds everyday convenience by allowing multiple drivers to save personalized settings for the power driver's seat, outside mirrors, and steering column, automatically recalling preferred positions at the touch of a button.

Technology is equally impressive. The Z06 features Chevrolet MyLink with an 8-inch touchscreen, built-in navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, Apple CarPlay capability, premium Bose audio system, performance data recorder availability, configurable digital driver information display, head-up display, dual-zone automatic climate control, keyless access with push-button start, wireless phone charging, and a rearview camera.

Performance extends far beyond straight-line speed. Magnetic Ride Control continuously adjusts the suspension for exceptional ride quality and handling, while the electronic limited-slip differential, Brembo performance brakes, Performance Traction Management, selectable drive modes, and advanced aerodynamic design deliver incredible confidence on both the street and the racetrack.

Safety features include Performance Traction Management, Electronic Stability Control, Anti-Lock Braking System, multiple airbags, rearview camera, curb view front cameras, available front and rear parking sensors, and Chevrolet's advanced lightweight aluminum structure engineered for maximum occupant protection.

Owners consistently praise the 2015 Corvette Z06 3LZ for its phenomenal supercharged V8 performance, world-class handling, luxurious interior, everyday drivability, and incredible value compared to European exotics. This 2021 Dodge Challenger R/T Scat Pack Widebody in striking Red commands attention from every angle. The muscular widebody design paired with aggressive performance-oriented appointments makes a statement about the driver behind the wheel. You're looking at a vehicle that combines genuine performance capability with modern convenience features designed for daily driving.

The SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine delivers substantial power, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission that provides smooth gear transitions. The Widebody Competition Suspension and Adaptive Damping work together to manage the vehicle's dynamics, while the four wheel independent suspension contributes to overall handling balance. The Brembo 6-pot fixed front caliper brakes with red calipers provide confidence in stopping performance.

The 20" x 11" Devil's Rim aluminum wheels suit the vehicle's aggressive stance and complement the Widebody fender flares. The SRT Performance Spoiler and MOPAR Shaker Hood reinforce the high-performance aesthetic. Heated door mirrors, high-intensity discharge headlamps, and fully automatic headlight functionality enhance both visibility and convenience in various driving conditions.

Inside, the cabin reflects attention to detail with premium-stitched dash panels, sport steering wheel, and Scat Pack logo houndstooth seating. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel provide comfort during cold weather. The Uconnect 4C system with 8.4" display integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected to your devices. SiriusXM satellite radio is ready to go with a one-year Guardian trial included.

Safety and convenience features include Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection, ParkView rear backup camera, dual front impact airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control. Power windows, power steering, power multi-function foldaway mirrors, and remote keyless entry round out the modern convenience package. Front and rear anti-roll bars contribute to responsive handling characteristics.

With 37,897 miles, this R/T Scat Pack Widebody remains well-cared-for and ready for its next owner. The combination of genuine performance engineering, contemporary technology, and bold styling makes this Challenger an appealing option for those seeking a direct, uncompromising driving experience.

We invite you to schedule a time to view and test drive this vehicle. Contact us at (539)-250-4208 or visit Grubbs Nissan of Tulsa at 8190 E Skelly Drive to experience this Challenger firsthand.

description:
The 2004 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra Base is a performance-oriented coupe from Ford's Special Vehicle Team lineup. It reflects the final years of the New Edge Mustang body style and was built as a focused version of the standard Mustang. This model year is associated with the 4.6-liter supercharged V8 used in the SVT Cobra, along with rear-wheel drive and a manual transmission. The car was positioned above the regular Mustang trims and was developed with stronger acceleration and more serious driving hardware in mind than the mainstream V6 and GT models. Its mechanical specification gives it a place in the era of factory-built American performance cars without relying on extensive luxury content or unnecessary equipment.

The exterior design follows the familiar Mustang two-door profile, with a low hood line, short rear deck, and pronounced fender shapes. The SVT Cobra appearance package includes details that distinguish it from lesser versions, while still keeping the bodywork close to the original production shape. Fog lights are part of the listed equipment and are integrated into the front fascia. The car also includes the usual coupe proportions, with a driver-focused seating position and a cabin arranged around the front occupants. The overall design remains straightforward and mechanical in presentation, with the body structure and proportions serving the car's performance mission rather than trying to add visual complexity.

Inside, the cabin includes Leather Seats, which add a more finished surface to the seating areas than cloth trim. The interior remains consistent with the Mustang's two-door format, offering front buckets and a compact rear compartment. Controls are arranged in a conventional Ford layout, with straightforward instrumentation and accessible switchgear. Premium Audio is also included, providing an upgraded sound system compared with the most basic factory stereo equipment. The materials and features reflect a balance between daily use and the more specialized character of the SVT Cobra, with enough comfort content to make the car easier to live with without moving it away from its performance roots. Keyless Entry is part of the equipment list as well, adding convenience for access without changing the character of the vehicle's cabin.

This example combines the Cobra's mechanical identity with a set of options that make the car more usable in ordinary driving. The SVT model is known for its stronger powertrain and chassis tuning relative to the standard Mustang, and that foundation is the main reason for interest in this version. The listed equipment does not try to transform the car into a luxury coupe, and it does not obscure the fact that the focus remains on the drivetrain and the basic performance package. With just over 21,000 miles on the odometer, this vehicle remains in exceptional condition with plenty of service life ahead.

The interior showcases Black Vernasca leather upholstery paired with sport seats featuring ventilation and adjustable seat width for personalized comfort. The Premium Package elevates the driving experience with a Head-Up Display, Heated Steering Wheel, Heated Front Seats, and intuitive Gesture Control, allowing you to manage functions with hand movements. Climate control includes automatic temperature adjustment with dual-zone capability for driver and passenger.

Advanced technology defines the cabin experience. The Live Cockpit Pro system integrates navigation seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. Connected Package Pro services keep you informed and connected, while the Harman/Kardon Surround Sound System with ten speakers delivers premium audio quality throughout the cabin.

The Driving Assistance Professional Package provides comprehensive safety features including Active Driving Assistant Pro, Active Driving Assistant Plus, active cruise control with stop and go functionality, active lane keeping assistant with side collision avoidance, and traffic jam assistant. Styling details reflect M performance heritage through the Shadowline Package, featuring Extended Shadowline Trim and M Shadowline Lights that enhance the coupe's aggressive stance. The 19-inch M Double-Spoke Jet Black wheels wrapped in 225/40R19 front and 255/35R19 rear performance tires ensure confident handling and visual impact. Gold Certified 2022 Ford Mustang GT Premium Coupe with 41,672 miles, finished in Carbonized Gray Metallic with Ebony leather-trimmed power seats. This four-passenger sports coupe combines classic Mustang V8 performance, Premium comfort, modern driver-assistance technology, sharp GT styling, and Ford Gold Certified confidence for drivers throughout Wesley Chapel, Tampa, Clearwater, St. Petersburg, and Brooksville.

Power comes from Ford’s 5.0L Ti-VCT V8, rated at 450 horsepower. Paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and paddle shifters, this Mustang GT delivers the strong acceleration, responsive shifting, and unmistakable V8 character that make the GT one of the most recognizable performance cars on the road.

The 3.15 ratio limited-slip rear axle helps put power down with confidence, while independent rear suspension gives the Mustang a composed, planted feel through corners and during highway driving. Selectable Drive Modes allow the driver to adjust the car’s personality for different road conditions and preferences, while Track Apps provide performance-focused information for enthusiasts.

The Active Valve Performance Exhaust is a major upgrade, allowing the Mustang’s sound to better match the drive. It adds a more aggressive exhaust character when desired while keeping the car more livable for everyday use.

EPA estimates of 15 MPG city, 24 MPG highway, and 19 MPG combined reflect the performance-focused nature of the 5.0L V8. This Mustang is built for drivers who want authentic rear-wheel-drive muscle-car performance with the comfort and technology of a modern premium coupe.

Carbonized Gray Metallic gives this Mustang GT a sleek, serious appearance. Exterior highlights include 18-inch machined aluminum high-gloss black wheels, LED headlights with signature lighting, LED fog lamps, LED taillamps with sequential turn signals, hood vents, Pony projection lamps, rain-sensing windshield wipers, and a raised blade decklid spoiler.

Heated power mirrors include turn-signal indicators and memory functionality, while Easy Fuel capless fuel filling adds everyday convenience. The GT coupe’s long hood, fastback roofline, and wide stance give it the unmistakable profile that has defined Mustang for generations.

Inside, the Ebony cabin features leather-trimmed power seats and the upgraded feel of the GT Premium trim. Heated and cooled front seats provide year-round comfort, making the cabin more enjoyable during hot Florida afternoons and cooler mornings alike.

Equipment Group 401A adds Premier Trim with Color Accent Group and the 12-inch LCD digital instrument cluster. The configurable digital cluster gives the driver a modern performance display with customizable views for speed, vehicle data, trip information, and drive-mode settings.

Additional interior features include dual-zone electronic automatic climate control, heated leather-wrapped steering wheel with cruise and audio controls, ambient lighting, auto-dimming rearview mirror, illuminated sill plates, dual illuminated vanity mirrors, power windows and locks, smart-charging USB ports, 12-volt powerpoints, split-folding rear seat, and premium floor mats with accent stitching.

Technology includes SYNC 3 with an 8-inch touchscreen, AppLink, SiriusXM capability, voice-activated touchscreen navigation, FordPass Connect, Intelligent Access with Push-Button Start, Universal Garage Door Opener, and steering-wheel-mounted controls. The navigation system adds convenient route guidance for commuting, road trips, and unfamiliar destinations.

The Ford Safe & Smart Package adds Adaptive Cruise Control and voice-activated touchscreen navigation. Adaptive Cruise Control can help maintain a selected following distance from traffic ahead, adding convenience during longer highway drives.

This one-owner, homegrown 2022 Mercedes-Benz AMG GT 43 4-Door Coupe originally carried an MSRP of more than $111,800 and now offers one of the strongest performance-luxury values in the market. Finished in MANUFAKTUR Diamond White Metallic over rare Macchiato Beige and Magma Grey Exclusive Nappa Leather, this is not an ordinary GT 43. It combines dramatic styling, AMG engineering, executive comfort, and a factory specification that is difficult to duplicate.

This AMG GT 43 was sold new by Mercedes-Benz of St. Clair Shores, leased by one local owner, and serviced primarily by our factory-trained technicians throughout its life. CARFAX reports no accidents or damage, one-owner personal lease history, 15 documented service records, and genuine Homegrown status. The Warmth and Comfort Package brings a heated steering wheel, rapid-heating front seats, and heated front armrests for premium cold-weather comfort.

The anti-lock brake system with brake assist and four-wheel disc brakes provides confident stopping power. Low tire pressure monitoring adds another layer of proactive vehicle management.

The 71,982 miles on this example represent typical use for a vehicle of this age. The mechanical condition and overall presentation indicate conscientious maintenance and operation. This GT is ready to provide the next owner with authentic performance driving in a proven platform.

We invite you to schedule your visit and experience this Mustang firsthand.

This 2021 BMW 4 Series 430i xDrive offers refined German engineering with a striking black exterior and the confidence that comes with all-wheel drive capability.

- 2.0L 4-Cylinder TwinPower Turbo engine with 8-Speed Automatic Sport transmission
- All-Wheel Drive
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Compatibility

- Power moonroof

The heart of this 4 Series is its turbocharged 2.0L four-cylinder engine, engineered to deliver responsive performance while maintaining efficiency. The eight-speed automatic transmission adapts seamlessly to your driving style, whether navigating city streets or cruising the highway. With all-wheel drive, you gain confidence in varied weather conditions and terrain. Combined fuel economy reaches 28 mpg, balancing capability with practical operation.

Inside, you'll find a driver-focused cabin designed for both comfort and control. The sport seats feature heated front positions wrapped in quality SensaTec upholstery, while the heated steering wheel adds another layer of comfort during colder months. Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning ensures every passenger enjoys their ideal temperature. Power adjustments throughout—seats, windows, and door mirrors—put convenience at your fingertips.

Technology integration is seamless with Live Cockpit Pro and a full navigation system guiding your journeys. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility connect your smartphone naturally, while the SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L keeps entertainment flowing. The hi-fi sound system with ten speakers delivers quality audio throughout the cabin. Remote engine start means your 4 Series warms up before you step outside.

Safety is integrated throughout, with automatic headlights and rain-sensing wipers providing constant vigilance. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together for confident handling. The rear parking camera assists during reversing, while BMW Assist eCall provides emergency support with a single button press.

This 2021 BMW 4 Series 430i xDrive represents the perfect balance of performance, technology, and everyday practicality. With 51,145 miles, it has been carefully maintained and is ready for years of driving enjoyment. We invite you to schedule a time to experience this vehicle in person and discover why BMW owners return with confidence.

This 2017 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 3LT delivers authentic American performance in striking Black, combining timeless design with serious driving capabilities that reward every trip behind the wheel.

- 6.2L V8 engine with 460 horsepower and performance exhaust
- 8-Speed Paddle Shift with Automatic Modes
- Bose Premium 9-Speaker Audio System with SiriusXM
- Chevrolet MyLink with Navigation and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Head-Up Display
- GT Bucket Seats with heated and vented front seating
- Custom Leather Wrapped Interior Package
- Performance Data & Video Recorder
- 18" x 8.5" front and 19" x 10" rear black aluminum wheels
- Auto-Dimming Inside Frameless Rearview Mirror
- Front Curb View Cameras and Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Remote Vehicle Starter System
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Universal Home Remote
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control

The Corvette's handling prowess comes from four-wheel independent suspension, speed-sensing steering, and front and rear anti-roll bars that work together to inspire confidence whether you're navigating city streets or open roads. The 2.41 Limited-Slip Rear Axle Ratio enhances traction and control, while high-intensity discharge headlights with delay-off functionality provide visibility and convenience.

Inside, the 3LT trim surrounds you with premium materials including a leather steering wheel, leather shift knob, and sueded microfiber-wrapped interior trim. The driver's seat features eight-way power adjustment and lumbar support, while both front seats offer heating and ventilation functions. Climate control includes automatic temperature management with front dual zone air conditioning and rear window defrosting.

Your entertainment and connectivity needs are well served with Chevrolet MyLink navigation, a premium audio system, and smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Steering wheel-mounted controls keep your focus on the road, and the remote keyless entry with vehicle starter system adds modern convenience to this classic performance car.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, occupant sensing airbags, and a low tire pressure warning system. The anti-lock braking system with four-wheel disc brakes provides stopping confidence, while the electronic stability and traction control systems help maintain grip in varying conditions.

This Corvette represents the intersection of heritage and modern capability, built for enthusiasts who appreciate genuine performance and quality engineering. We invite you to experience this vehicle in person and discover why this generation of Corvette remains a remarkable expression of automotive excellence and driving satisfaction.

This 2015 Ford Mustang GT Premium in Race Red represents a refined American performance classic with genuine single-owner history and moderate mileage.

- ONE OWNER
- 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine with 6-speed transmission
- Shaker Pro Audio System with SiriusXM Radio
- SYNC w/MyFord Touch infotainment
- Blind Spot Information System with Cross-Traffic Alert
- Heated leather front seats with ventilation
- Memory driver seat and mirrors
- Rear view camera
- HD Radio
- HID headlights with fog lights
- Equipment Group 401A
- Rear window defroster
- Electronic stability and traction control
- 18-inch machined alloy wheels

The 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine delivers authentic performance capability, paired with a smooth 6-speed transmission and rear-wheel drive setup that defines the Mustang experience. This powertrain achieves 15 city and 25 highway MPG, balancing performance with reasonable fuel efficiency for its class.

The GT Premium trim elevates the ownership experience through genuine leather bucket seats with heated and ventilated capabilities, complemented by a power-adjustable driver seat. The memory driver seat and mirrors add convenience for regular users, while the front dual-zone climate control ensures individual comfort for driver and passenger.

Technology integration centers on SYNC with MyFord Touch, providing voice-controlled access to entertainment and vehicle functions. The Shaker Pro Audio System delivers quality sound through nine speakers, enhanced by both HD Radio and SiriusXM satellite radio for diverse listening options. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep primary functions within convenient reach.

Safety and visibility benefit from the Blind Spot Information System with Cross-Traffic Alert, providing additional awareness during lane changes and parking maneuvers. The rear view camera assists with backing, while HID headlights and integrated fog lights improve nighttime and adverse weather driving. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension contribute to predictable handling characteristics.

Additional amenities include automatic temperature control, remote keyless entry, illuminated entry, telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjustments, and a trip computer with outside temperature display. The split-folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo accommodation when needed.

This Mustang GT Premium combines enthusiast-level performance with practical daily-use features, backed by genuine single-owner maintenance history and modest 38,976 miles. We invite you to examine this vehicle in person and take it for a test drive.

This 2015 Ford Mustang GT Premium 50th Anniversary represents a significant moment in automotive history, combining the raw performance of the GT model with commemorative styling that celebrates five decades of iconic design.

- Blind Spot Info System with Cross-Traffic Alert
- Shaker Pro Audio System with 12 speakers
- Memory Driver Seat & Mirrors with 3 settings
- 50 Years Appearance Package with unique badging and trim
- 50 Years Grille with Bright Surround
- Voice-Activated Navigation System with SiriusXM Traffic and Travel Link
- 6-Speed Automatic with SelectShift and Paddle Shifters
- 3.55 Limited Slip Rear Axle
- Remote Start System
- Enhanced Security Package with electronic locking center console
- 19" Luster Nickel Premium Painted Aluminum Wheels
- HD Radio
- Reverse Park Assist
- High-Intensity Discharge Headlights
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear

Powered by a 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine paired with a 6-Speed Automatic transmission featuring SelectShift capability, this Mustang delivers the performance enthusiasts expect from the GT designation. The rear-wheel-drive configuration combined with the 3.55 limited slip rear axle provides confident handling and responsive acceleration. With 28,264 miles on the odometer, this vehicle remains well within its prime, offering years of reliable ownership ahead.

The Silver exterior finish showcases the distinctive 50th Anniversary styling elements, including the commemorative grille with bright surround, unique seat inserts with cashmere stitching, and exclusive door sill plates. The 19-inch Luster Nickel premium painted wheels complement the special anniversary appearance while maintaining the aggressive stance Mustang owners demand.

Inside, the cabin features front bucket seats with power adjustment, an auto-dimming rear-view mirror, and the memory driver seat system that stores three preferred seating positions. The Shaker Pro Audio System with 12 speakers brings premium sound quality to your daily drives, while the voice-activated navigation system with five years of included SiriusXM service keeps you connected and informed.

Safety and security have been prioritized with the Enhanced Security Package, which includes an active anti-theft system, electronic steering column lock, and wheel locking kit. The blind spot information system with cross-traffic alert adds an extra layer of awareness during lane changes and parking maneuvers.

This 50th Anniversary Mustang GT Premium combines collector appeal with genuine performance capability. With its anniversary-specific styling, advanced features, and the legendary V8 power that defines the GT nameplate, this vehicle stands as a tribute to Mustang's enduring legacy while remaining a thoroughly capable and enjoyable driver. We invite you to visit us for a closer look at this special edition.

This 2013 Ford Mustang GT delivers authentic American muscle with a gray exterior that commands attention on any road. With just over 27,000 miles, this well-maintained example offers the classic performance and styling that make the Mustang an icon.

- 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT 32V engine with 6-speed manual transmission
- 3.73 limited slip rear axle
- Charcoal black Recaro cloth sport seats
- High-intensity discharge headlights with front fog lights
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Remote keyless entry
- Power windows, power door mirrors, and power steering
- 18-inch sparkle silver painted aluminum wheels
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags

The heart of this Mustang is its proven 5.0L V8 engine paired with a manual transmission—a combination that puts genuine driving engagement at your fingertips. The 3.73 limited slip rear axle ensures confident handling and traction when you need it, whether cruising the highway or taking a spirited drive. Fuel economy reaches 26 highway miles per gallon, offering reasonable efficiency for a performance vehicle of this caliber.

The interior features comfortable Recaro sport seats in charcoal black cloth, designed to keep you secure during spirited cornering. You'll find convenient touches throughout, including steering wheel audio controls, speed control, and a tilt steering wheel that adapts to your preference. The trip computer and outside temperature display provide practical information at a glance.

Safety systems are comprehensive and modern. Electronic stability control works seamlessly with traction control to maintain grip, while dual front impact and side impact airbags provide protection. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS give you confident stopping power from any speed. Speed-sensing steering adjusts effort based on vehicle speed for better control in all driving conditions.

The exterior design captures the aggressive stance Mustang owners appreciate. The body-color bumpers, spoiler, and fully automatic headlights combine function with purpose. The 18-inch sparkle silver aluminum wheels showcase clean styling while the high-intensity discharge headlights cut through the darkness with clarity.

This 2013 Mustang GT represents a straightforward ownership proposition: authentic V8 performance, proven reliability, and the satisfaction of driving a genuine American performance car. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience what this classic muscle car delivers.

The sport pedals and manual transmission combine with suspension refinement to create a cohesive performance platform. Ground Effects Package styling enhances the visual presence while the 20-inch wheels fill the body lines distinctly.

This Camaro has been maintained with available service records and carries a Carfax report showing two previous owners. With 40,247 miles, this vehicle has been used moderately and is ready for years of enjoyment. Visit our showroom to experience the driver-focused character this Camaro SS 2SS delivers.
